name: Creator Chronicles
summary: 公会长经营模拟 RPG，2026 年 9 月 14 日上市，Origin Studio 开发并由 Origin Studio 与 Gamersky Games 发行。商店披露只有一句：为游戏内部分美术资源的开发使用了生成式 AI 工具，未点名素材类别与数量；其余七个领域都是披露未说明。

sources.label: Feedback: House building costs are way too high compared to income generation
sources.excerpt: I'm really enjoying playing Creator Chronicles, but I wanted to share some feedback regarding the economy in the game. Currently, building or upgrading houses costs an absolute fortune. At the same time, earning money takes a significant amount of time and effort. This makes progression feel a bit discouraging, as it takes forever just to afford a single new home. Could the developers please consider rebalancing the economy? Lowering the construction costs or slightly increasing the income rates would make the game much more enjoyable and balanced. Thanks for reading!

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Origin Studio，发行商 Origin Studio 与 Gamersky Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 275），首页有 1 个被自动匹配为相关的主题（“Feedback: House building costs are way too high compared to income generation”），已逐帖读取原文：内容是玩家抱怨建房成本相对收益过高、请求重新平衡经济数值，与生成式 AI 无关，按无关主题登记，不改变任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 本作页复刻商店披露并按领域给出结构化结论，同时标注其“模型自评置信度 95%”是模型估计而非人工审核分数，属转录而非独立核实）。其余结果为一个标题为玩家美术讨论的讨论区主题帖（本轮未读取正文，帖内亦无开发方对生成式 AI 的说明）、SteamDB 图表页、本作商店页、一段 YouTube 玩法视频与 GamingBible 的免费试玩推荐文章（只谈玩法与观感，未涉及本作披露）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: We used generative AI tools for the development of some in-game art resources.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A guild-master simulation RPG released on Sep 14, 2026, developed by Origin Studio and published by Origin Studio and Gamersky Games. The disclosure is one sentence stating that generative AI tools were used to develop some in-game art resources, with no asset category or quantity named; the other seven areas are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Origin Studio, publishers Origin Studio and Gamersky Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 275), where one topic matched the AI keyword screen; it was opened and read in full and turns out to be a player asking for the economy to be rebalanced because house building costs are high relative to income, which has nothing to do with generative AI, so it is logged as unrelated and changes no area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source was read: an AI Transparency Index page reproducing the store disclosure and giving a structured area breakdown, which labels its own 95 percent figure as a model estimate rather than a human review score, so it is a transcription and not independent verification. The remaining results were a discussion thread about character artwork that was not read and contains no developer statement on generative AI, a SteamDB charts page, the store page, a YouTube gameplay video and a GamingBible free trial recommendation that discusses the game rather than its disclosure. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
